Physics simulations run faster when using simple shapes instead of the fine detail of a node’s visible geometry. Typically, you set a body’s physics shape to a bounding box, sphere, or primitive shape that roughly matches its node’s visible content. For details on creating physics shapes, see [`SCNPhysicsShape`](scnphysicsshape.md).
